title: Exam prep
summary: A step-by-step plan for the weeks before exams: past questions, revision timetables, practice under exam conditions and exam-day technique.
description: Good exam results come from a plan that starts weeks before the exam, not from the night before. This roadmap takes you from working out what will be examined to walking out of the hall, and what to do with your results afterwards.

stages.title: Six weeks out
stages.summary: Find out what's examined and build a realistic plan.

stages.title: Two to five weeks out
stages.summary: Practise retrieving and applying what you know.

nodes.title: Know what's being examined
nodes.description: Collect the course outline, learning outcomes and past questions, then list the topics that come up most and how marks are split between them.

nodes.title: Build a revision timetable
nodes.description: Spread topics across the weeks you have left, interleave subjects, and schedule review sessions for topics you've already covered.

nodes.title: Work through past questions
nodes.description: Past questions show the style, depth and wording examiners use. Attempt them before looking at answers, then mark yourself honestly.

nodes.title: Practice testing and active recall
nodes.description: Turn each topic into questions and answer them from memory. Keep an error log of what you got wrong and revisit it every few days.

nodes.title: Revising with a study group
nodes.description: Groups work best when everyone prepares first and the session is spent quizzing each other and explaining tricky ideas, not reading notes together.

nodes.title: Exam technique
nodes.description: Plan your time per question by marks, read every question first, answer what is asked, and show working so you collect method marks even when the final answer is wrong.

resources.title: Test day game plan (UNC Learning Center)

nodes.title: Managing exam stress
nodes.description: Some nerves help performance. Breathing techniques, sleep, and a clear plan for the morning of the exam keep them from tipping into panic.

nodes.title: Review your results
nodes.description: After results come out, compare your marks with your error log and plan. Note which revision methods worked so next semester's plan starts stronger.

resources.title: Learn from past exams with the test analyzer (UNC Learning Center)
